$comment: Advisories consciously waived for the frontend dependency-audit gate.
Every waiver needs a reason that argues why THIS codebase is not exposed,
and an expiry so it gets re-reviewed instead of living forever.
Enforced by scripts/audit-gate.mjs — an expired waiver fails CI.

waivers.reason: RSC Mode CSRF bypass: a request to an RSC server action runs before the 400 response is returned. This app is a Vite SPA that renders entirely client-side via react-router-dom's BrowserRouter — it does not use RSC mode, server actions, or any react-router server runtime, so the vulnerable path is not reachable. No patched release exists on the react-router-dom line (7.18.2 is the last, and it pins react-router 7.18.2); the fix ships in react-router 8.3.0, which requires migrating off the react-router-dom package. Tracked as a separate migration.
